research_control_plan.policy: Round692 may only preregister a PEAD gap-overreaction reversal source-repair audit on the expanded statement source. Formula grid expansion, portfolio grids, promotion, sign/window tuning, mixed-window harvesting, live trading, and final-holdout reads remain blocked.

data_source_plan.available_date_rule: Use the first valid trading date strictly after ann_date. Same-day announcement trading and period-end-only signals are blocked.
data_source_plan.event_reaction_rule: Measure the event gap only after the announcement is observable, then date factors on the next tradable day after the event-reaction observation.
data_source_plan.provider_limit_policy: Use local processed PIT statement cache only. Do not download or extend source data during Round692 candidate-plan gate.

candidates.formula: negative event_gap measured from the first post-announcement reaction window on the expanded statement source; 5D forward label only
candidates.hypothesis_source: Round223 PEAD gap-overreaction reversal lead, repaired by Round690 expanded PIT statement source rather than by changing the economic formula.
candidates.economic_rationale: Large post-announcement gaps can overreact to newly observable accounting information; a same-direction reversal score tests whether the expanded source preserves the residual signal.

candidates.formula: negative event_gap divided by one plus absolute event volume surprise; 5D forward label only
candidates.hypothesis_source: Round223 best residual IC PEAD gap-overreaction reversal variant, tested as a source-expansion repair on Round690 statement rows.
candidates.economic_rationale: Penalizing extreme volume surprise reduces the chance that the event gap only captures liquidity shocks rather than overreaction to accounting news.

candidates.formula: negative event_gap multiplied by one plus absolute event volume surprise; 5D forward label only
candidates.hypothesis_source: Round223 preregistered PEAD gap-overreaction reversal family, replayed only because the statement source expanded materially in Round690.
candidates.economic_rationale: If volume confirms attention rather than permanent information, high-attention announcement gaps may have stronger short-horizon reversal after controls.

candidates.formula: negative event_gap multiplied by one minus 0.25 times centered event amount rank; 5D forward label only
candidates.hypothesis_source: Round223 preregistered PEAD gap-overreaction reversal family with size-style containment, replayed on expanded statement coverage.
candidates.economic_rationale: Explicitly dampening larger event-amount names tests whether the reversal is not merely a size or high-information-flow proxy.

candidates.formula: negative event_gap plus 0.2 times cross-sectional zscore of PIT-safe fundamental_delta; 5D forward label only
candidates.hypothesis_source: Round223 preregistered quality-conditioned PEAD gap reversal, source-repaired with Round690 statement rows and PIT-safe announcement timing.
candidates.economic_rationale: A small quality condition can separate transient price overreaction from accounting information that is more likely to persist.

safety: Research-to-review only. No broker connection, no account reads, no order placement, no live trading.
